families.selection: The official SampleSet directory contains complete photographs and corresponding data for scans 1 and 6 only. Its other scan IDs have observability metadata without the photographs. The public catalogue identifies both scenes separately. Neither appears in the official rotated-scene groups. Check the catalogue thumbnails for physical identity independently of the test results. If unresolved, limit claims to acquisition identity; if near duplicates, group them into one family.

camera.native_rgb: official Rectified scanN/rect_NNN_3_r5000.png, right camera. Treat supplied RGB8 as display RGB under the released scorer convention; sensor response and transfer function were not independently measured.

image.color: RGB8 display values without exposure, alignment or fitted colour transformation
image.resampling: Pillow LANCZOS in the supplied display RGB encoding; half-pixel centres

optimizer.conditioning: same rigid metric transform based on shared endpoints; fixed original random box, no object scale fit

engineering.native_projection: Verify original P against full OpenCV crop K and metric C2W, including noncentral principal point, axial depth and off-axis points, before photos. Verify gsplat ED on the actual backend.
engineering.frozen_worker: finite parameters and gradients, 4096 fixed parameters sets, nonempty support and common-checkpoint/source-image identity per condition; finite legal RGB and alpha in [0,1]; supported ED is finite and positive, NaN is allowed off support. A constant-black image or no supported pixels invalidates reconstruction. Report failures at their original stage plus counts.
engineering.interpretation: Assess engineering and source-reconstruction quality first, then target RGB error prevalence and frozen risk. No filtering on target errors, scores, material, confidence or alpha.

evaluation.primary: absolute per-pixel mean in display RGB > float32(0.05), no exposure correction or target alignment
evaluation.domain: all 256x256 center-crop RGB pixels with valid reference; a nonfinite or missing prediction reduces E, never V. Prediction alpha is not a reference mask. Retain all targets, conditions and failures.
evaluation.object_domain_reason: Official ObsMask is a 3D visibility volume for point-distance evaluation. No independently verified dense image silhouette is supplied. No hole-filled or predicted-alpha object mask.
evaluation.E: comparable reference and prediction within V
evaluation.L: low state on S at released method threshold
evaluation.LY: low state with original RGB error label
evaluation.ap: old tied-score grouped AP on the common four-method support and separately each deployment support. Require both labels, mean of eligible views per object then equal eligible objects. Retain number of views, objects, positive/negative counts.
evaluation.auxiliary: 3x3 minimum of center prediction vs valid in-domain neighbor reference RGB, bounded at crop edge with center included. Same E; no fictitious padding. Fixed 10-bin descriptive ECE and Brier if emitted.
no_inference: cross-object confidence intervals for a single object

data_rights.source_terms: SampleSet/ReadMe.txt asks users to cite Jensen et al., CVPR 2014. Source used for research evaluation.
data_rights.public: original code, file names and checksums, protocols, bibliographic attribution, numeric results and sanitized receipts
